text: The ball glowed for the first time when the pass reached the player nobody had noticed. The ball glowed for the first time when the pass reached the player nobody had noticed. A silver line swept across the neighborhood field and joined the Comets like a constellation. Jordan saw the space, Sam dropped back, Maya played the simple pass, Mei chose the moment and Noah kept running. The goal did not belong to one star. The whole sky had been drawn by the team.
